description: Corporate Energy Consumption is a dataset listed in City of Calgary open data portal (data.calgary.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Calgary. Energy consumption at City facilities. This raw data is subject to periodic adjustments and modifications. Check out: Calgary's Sustainable Building Policy. Coverage: Calgary. The portal files it under the category Environment. Its tags are district, natural gas, solar, energy, electricity. The table has 9 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-calgary-ca-portal.
